notes: This contract records the portable C++ TCK check for standard timestamped object deletion followed by local deletion at one recipient. The source uses only the standard C++ RTIambassador and FederateAmbassador APIs plus the standard library; the adapter supplies the provider package, FOM, endpoint, callback configuration, and logical-time implementation. It verifies that local deletion suppresses only the local queued removal while another recipient receives the exact timestamped removal and retraction metadata, without asserting provider-specific names, registries, headers, or implementation behavior.

api_surfaces.signature: RTIambassador timestamped deleteObjectInstance/localDeleteObjectInstance and FederateAmbassador timestamped removeObjectInstance delivery
api_surfaces.source_symbol: IEEE 1516.1 RTIambassador object-deletion and local-delete declarations
